description: Tails authentication logs for bursts of failed logins from one source and for a successful login that follows such a burst.
name: failed_login_watch

signals.description: One source accumulated at least burst_count failed logins within the trailing window_sec.
signals.name: login_failure_burst

signals.description: A successful login came from a source whose failure burst is active or which has at least burst_count recent failures.
signals.name: login_success_after_burst
